decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch with its own product page, this upholstery fabric reflects visible commitment and recent investment, so management is likely to keep backing it and treat any early weakness as temporary.

This decorative fabric appears less prominently committed than products with their own page, but because it is still a very recent launch, management would usually continue it rather than reverse course quickly.

Its own page and technically differentiated flame-retardant curtain positioning suggest a stronger public and development commitment, which under escalation of commitment makes withdrawal unlikely after only one year.
Although only mentioned on the website, this double-face wool-blend decoration fabric is still new enough that management would likely justify continued support instead of admitting an early misstep.

This niche semi-transparent wool bouclé leno fabric has the weakest visible commitment among the group, so its drop risk is somewhat higher, but recent investment and the tendency to persist still make keeping it more likely than dropping it.
